evidence: Touches `src/index/txindex.cpp` to check iterator status and report database read failures in `TxIndex::FindTx()`.
rationale: Fixes a data integrity bug where `TxIndex::FindTx()` silently returns `std::nullopt` instead of throwing an error when encountering LevelDB read errors or database corruption. In the indexes category, returning wrong answers on corruption is treated as a priority data integrity concern.
